newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brown Bros Harriman cuts banks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brown Bros Harriman cuts banks.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer cut shorr-term ratings on four big banks and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc to hold from buy.
-- Analyst cuts Citicorp, BankAmerica Corp, J.P. Morgan & Co, Chase Manhattan Corp to hold from buy short term
-- Analyst says lowered rating based on "market's likely reaction" to Fed rate hike.
-- For longer term, outperform rating is maintained on J.P. Morgan and Merrill, long term on other three upgraded to outperform from market perform.
